caption: The drawing features two representations of the same hat. The larger, left-side illustration is a detailed, colored depiction of a black, high-crowned hat with a wide brim. The hat is decorated with a black satin ribbon encircling the crown and forming a large bow on the left side, with two long ribbon tails hanging down. The upper edge of the brim features a wavy trim. The right-side illustration is an outlined sketch of the same hat, showing the hat’s structure, ribbon, bow, and tails in much less detail, rendered in fine lines and shaded lightly with grey. The artist's signature “PESSEL” appears beneath the sketch. The background of the image is a plain, light-colored surface.
title: Bonnet
